english.title: Uncertified / unapproved person provide air traffic controller training
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) provided training necessary to obtain from the CAA

(A)_[student air traffic control licences or the maintenance of such licences]_
(B)_[air traffic control licences or the maintenance of such licences]_
(C)_[a rating associated with a student air traffic control licence]_
(D)_[a rating associated with an air traffic control licence]_
(E)_[an endorsement associated with a student air traffic control licence]_
(F)_[an endorsement associated with an air traffic control licence]_

when

(G)_[not holding training organisation certification issued or recognised by the CAA in accordance with]_
(H)_[the training had not been approved by the CAA in accordance with Article 22(2)(d) of]_

the EASA Air Traffic Controller Licensing Regulation
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 196 and 265(5) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
provided training necessary to obtain from the CAA student air traffic control licences or air traffic control licences
associated rating or endorsement or to maintain any of them
when not holding training organisation certification issued or recognised by the CAA in accordance with, OR
the training had not been approved by the CAA in accordance with Article 22(2)(d) of,
the EASA Air Traffic Controller Licensing Regulation.
